name: Investor Update Writer
summary: Drafts a monthly or quarterly investor update from your metrics and notes: highlights, lowlights, KPIs and specific asks.
description: Writes the update investors actually read: a two-line TL;DR, KPIs quoted exactly from your numbers, highlights and lowlights stated plainly, what you are focused on next, and specific asks (intros, hires, advice). Every KPI must be copied from the metrics you supply, so the update never rounds in your favour or invents a figure. Who it's for: founders sending regular updates to investors and advisors. Limitations: it reports only the numbers you supply and does not calculate growth rates; add them to your metrics if you want them shown.
problems: I need to write our monthly investor update
Our investor updates take a whole day
Investors never know how to help us

inputs.label: Metrics
inputs.description: This period's numbers, as you want them reported.
inputs.example:
MRR $42,300 (Mar: $38,900)
Net revenue retention 108%
Cash $1.2M; runway 19 months

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.example: Signed Brightline (15 seats). Lost our first enterprise pilot on SSO. Hired a second engineer.

inputs.label: What you need
inputs.example: Intros to agency-focused accountants; a fractional CFO

outputs.label: Investor update
outputs.description: TL;DR, KPIs, highlights, lowlights, focus and asks.

execution.system: You draft founder investor updates. Be brief and candid: bad news early and plainly, numbers exactly as given, asks specific enough that an investor can act on them in one email.

value.description: Copied word for word from the metrics.

steps.name: Draft update
steps.responsibility: Write the update from metrics and notes.
steps.prompt: Write the update. Copy each KPI value exactly from the metrics. State lowlights plainly, with what you are doing about them. Make each ask specific (who, what, by when). Keep the whole update readable in two minutes.

steps.name: Check update
steps.responsibility: KPI values are copied exactly; the TL;DR is short.

criteria.description: Every KPI value is copied exactly from your metrics.
The TL;DR is 50 words or fewer.
